lines.en: label iospring7:
scene clearnightsky
Apparently, night has come. And apparently, I am once again naked in the presence of a girl who would much prefer me to not be naked probably ever.
lines.zh: 显然，夜幕降临了。而显然，我又一次赤身裸体地待在一个大概宁可我这辈子都别脱光的女孩面前。

lines.en: Yet, she is the one who crafted this occasion- albeit with a fervor drastically unlike that with which she crafts everything else. She’s like a contractor, though.
lines.zh: 然而，正是她一手促成了这个场合——尽管她做这件事时的热忱，和她做其他任何事情时那股热忱截然不同。不过她像个承包商。

lines.en: The type you pay to come over and figure out how to improve your living situation because you couldn’t ever be bothered to figure things out on your own.
lines.zh: 就是你花钱请上门、替你琢磨该怎么改善居住状况的那种人，因为你自己永远懒得去把事情弄明白。

lines.en: Maybe you were just busy. Maybe you didn’t have the time. Or maybe you were repeatedly molested at a young age as well and are now permanently emotionally stunted as a result of that.
lines.zh: 也许你只是忙。也许你没有时间。又或者你年幼时也曾反复遭到猥亵，于是如今在情感上永久地发育停滞。

lines.en: Whatever the case, it’s probably fine to lean on others to compensate for things you lack. But when the person you’re leaning on is lacking as well, it starts to feel like everything is hopeless.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，靠别人来补足自己缺失的东西，大概也没什么不好。但当你所倚靠的那个人本身也有所缺失时，一切就开始显得毫无希望。

lines.en: Or perhaps “pointless” would be a better way to describe it?
lines.zh: 又或者，用「毫无意义」来形容会更贴切？

lines.en: We don’t have to be here. Io doesn’t have to be crawling outside of her box just to peek inside of mine. But I’m the cat in this scenario, and she thinks she has adopted me.
lines.zh: 我们本不必在这儿。Io 本不必爬出她的盒子，只为了往我的盒子里偷看一眼。但在这个场景里我是那只猫，而她以为自己收养了我。

lines.en: So, for the experiment’s sake, let’s say there’s a world where this didn’t happen. Where I kept my clothes on and went home.
lines.zh: 那么，为了这个实验起见，假设存在一个没有发生这一切的世界。在那个世界里我穿着衣服，回家去了。

lines.en: Would the Io in that world be happier than the one here? Would I be happier as well?
lines.zh: 那个世界里的 Io，会比这里的这一个更幸福吗？我也会更幸福吗？

lines.en: And, if we exist in both of these places at once, which outcome would a computer select if you commanded it to choose the “better” route?
lines.zh: 而如果我们同时存在于这两个地方，当你命令一台计算机去选择「更好」的那条路线时，它会选中哪个结果？

lines.en: Anyway, it’s not like this matters. Keeping any sort of cat in any kind of box is a form of animal cruelty.
lines.zh: 反正，这也不重要。把任何一只猫关在任何一种盒子里，都是一种虐待动物。

lines.en: But, in thinking that, I realize just how much of a sinner I am.
lines.zh: 但这么一想，我才意识到自己是个多大的罪人。

lines.en: And that being this way will keep it harder for any inner-monologue to stave off the inevitable erection I am going to get being around Io like this.
lines.zh: 而正因为如此，任何内心独白都更难抵挡住——这样待在 Io 身边时，我不可避免会产生的那种生理反应。

lines.en: scene iohj1
: You know it’s even weirder if you don’t talk, right? Like, I get bathhouses are meant to be relaxing and all, but I don’t think they’re supposed to make you catatonic.
lines.zh: : 你知道你不说话反而更奇怪吧？我是说，我知道澡堂本来就是为了让人放松什么的，但我不觉得它应该把你弄得像得了紧张症一样。

lines.en: : You underestimate the amount of self-control it takes to stay normal in a situation like this.
lines.zh: : 你低估了在这种情况下保持正常需要多少自制力。

lines.en: : Muscle memory?
lines.zh: : 肌肉记忆？

lines.en: scene iohj2
: You think?
lines.zh: : 你这么想？

lines.en: : Probably. Or habit, at the very least. Just what happens to you is a lot less debilitating than the nausea I normally get when I’m touched.
lines.zh: : 大概是。或者至少是习惯。只是发生在你身上的事，远没有我被人触碰时通常会感到的那种恶心来得让人瘫软。

lines.en: : Which isn’t me trying to say my trauma is worse or anything. We just manifest it a little differently, I think.
lines.zh: : 我可不是在说我的创伤比你的更严重什么的。我们只是表现方式不太一样，我觉得。

lines.en: : I think it’s fair to say you have it worse. I don’t usually call what happened to me “traumatic” in the first place. Just...pivotal in my development.
lines.zh: : 我觉得说你的情况更糟也算公允。我通常根本不会把发生在我身上的事称作「创伤」。只是……对我的成长起了关键作用。

lines.en: scene iohj3
: That just sounds like an overly-positive way to say “trauma.” I know what it really is though, Sensei. You can’t hide trash from the trash-queen.
lines.zh: : 那听起来只是「创伤」的一种过于正面的说法。不过我知道它到底是什么，Sensei。你没法在垃圾女王面前藏垃圾。

lines.en: : So does talking about this...not bother you anymore? Because you kept it hidden for a while, Io. And I can’t say the reveal was all that nice.
lines.zh: : 那现在谈论这些……不再困扰你了吗？因为你曾经把它藏了很久，Io。而且说实在的，那次揭穿的场面可算不上好。

lines.en: : You kept your story hidden too and you seem to be doing fine. Or...fine-adjacent.
lines.zh: : 你的故事也藏了很久，可你看起来过得还行。或者……勉强算还行。

lines.en: : Plus, I’m used to talking about stuff like this with people who’ve experienced similar things. Just look at Uta.
lines.zh: : 再说，我早就习惯跟有相似经历的人聊这种事了。看看 Uta 就知道了。

lines.en: : Kind of makes sense in hindsight why I took to you so quickly with that in mind. I feel less weird about my attachment issues now.
lines.zh: : 这么一想，我当初那么快就黏上你也就说得通了。现在我倒不那么觉得自己那点依恋问题有多奇怪了。

lines.en: : Uta’s situation is horrible for sure...but it’s a lot different than ours. Did talking to her really help?
lines.zh: : Uta 的处境确实很糟……但跟我们的不太一样。跟她聊真的有帮助吗？

lines.en: scene iohj4
: Not in the sense that it helped me accept who I am. But in the sense of having somebody to connect with who didn’t just want to hurt me, yeah.
lines.zh: : 不是在「帮助我接纳自己」这个意义上。而是「有一个跟我相连、却并不只是想伤害我的人」这个意义上，是的。

lines.en: : Have you adequately convinced yourself I don’t want to hurt you either then?
lines.zh: : 那么你已经充分说服自己，我也不想伤害你了吗？

lines.en: : First yes, then no. Now, I’m leaning back toward yes since I’ve recovered from the sex scene. You were super creepy that night, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 先是，然后否。现在我又偏向「是」了，因为我已经从那场性事里恢复过来了。那天晚上你超级恶心，Sensei。

lines.en: : Yeah...that happens sometimes. But I won’t burden you with yet another apology since you’ll just spin it into you not deserving one.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那种事偶尔会发生。不过我不会再拿又一次道歉来烦你了，因为你只会把它解读成你不配得到道歉。

lines.en: : Where’d that come from anyway? It was like a switch flipped and you were suddenly a textbook grown-up.
lines.zh: : 话说那到底是怎么回事？就像一个开关被拨了一下，你突然就变成了一个教科书式的成年人。

lines.en: : That’s not what “grown-ups” are like, Io.
lines.zh: : 「成年人」不是那样的，Io。

lines.en: : The ones I know are. And it’s going to be hard to argue the opposite since you did the same exact thing after luring me into thinking you were one of the good ones.
lines.zh: : 我认识的那些就是。而且你想要反驳也很难，毕竟在骗得我以为你是好人之一以后，你做的正是同样的事。

lines.en: scene iohj5
: Okay. Maybe I will apologize again, then.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那也许我还是再道一次歉吧。

lines.en: : Seriously, it’s fine. I blew up and you just...went into damage control. But now we know we cope differently and it won’t happen again. Right?
lines.zh: : 说真的，没关系。我炸了，而你只是……去做了善后。不过现在我们知道彼此的应对方式不同，以后不会再发生了。对吧？

lines.en: : Right...
scene iohj6
: So being in this situation right now, then...how do you feel?
lines.zh: : 那么，现在处在这样的情境里……你感觉怎么样？

lines.en: : Do you need a few minutes to come up with an answer that won’t make you sound scary?
lines.zh: : 你需要几分钟来想出一个不会让你听起来很吓人的答案吗？

lines.en: : More like a few years. Ask me again then.
lines.zh: : 不如说需要几年。到那时再问我吧。

lines.en: scene iohj7
: You’re enjoying it then? It doesn’t feel counterintuitive being washed by someone so naturally unclean?
lines.zh: : 那你是在享受了？被一个天生就不干净的人搓洗，不会觉得违和吗？

lines.en: : I’m enjoying it, sure. And it doesn’t feel counterintuitive. But it still feels like I’m unintentionally forcing you to do this since I know you don’t want to.
lines.zh: : 我确实在享受。而且也不违和。可我仍然觉得，我是在无意中强迫你做这件事，因为我知道你并不想做。

lines.en: : I don’t mind things like this at all, Sensei. Being close physically when I can’t have sex makes stuff that probably seems normal for you actually really intimate for me.
lines.zh: : 我一点也不介意这种事，Sensei。在我没法做爱的前提下，身体上的靠近，会让那些对你来说大概很平常的事，对我来说变得非常亲密。

lines.en: scene iohj8
: Really?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Well, it’s not like I’m going to have an orgasm or anything. But yeah. I still want to connect with you in any way I can. Thanks for not hitting it and quitting it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我又不会因为这样就有高潮什么的。不过，是啊。我还是想用任何可能的方式跟你相连。谢谢你没上完就跑。

lines.en: scene iohj9
: I shouldn’t joke about that, should I?
lines.zh: : 我不该拿那个开玩笑的，是吧？

lines.en: : I’d prefer it if you didn’t, yeah.
lines.zh: : 我宁愿你别，是啊。

lines.en: : It’s only because it’s me, you know. I’d never make jokes like that about what happened to you.
lines.zh: : 只是因为那是我，你知道的。我绝不会拿发生在你身上的事开那种玩笑。

lines.en: : Io, come on...it’s not okay to talk about yourself like that either.
lines.zh: : Io，别这样……你那样说你自己也是不对的。

lines.en: : Maybe on paper, sure. But, as a sex-averse teenage girl, isn’t it kind of on me for putting all of my eggs in a basket belonging to a guy who just goes around and has sex with teenage girls every day?
lines.zh: : 也许从道理上讲是这样。但作为一个排斥性的少女，我把所有的鸡蛋都放进了一个每天都跟少女们上床的家伙的篮子里，这难道不是我自己活该吗？

lines.en: : You didn’t know that at the start, though.
lines.zh: : 可你一开始并不知道这些。

lines.en: : You’re right. I didn’t. But it wasn’t hard to figure out once I got to know you a little better. And I never backed out when I could have. So I had it coming.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我不知道。但只要稍微了解你一点，就不难猜到。而我本可以抽身的时候，我从来没有退过。所以是我自找的。

lines.en: : Okay. Message received. I will pretend to like myself a little more in your presence from now on.
lines.zh: : 好吧。收到。那我从今往后在你面前就假装多喜欢自己一点好了。

lines.en: : I’m not asking you to like yourself. Just maybe wait until you’re my age to start saying you deserve any of the misery coming your way.
lines.zh: : 我没要求你喜欢自己。只是也许等你到我这个年纪，再开始说你活该承受那些痛苦吧。

lines.en: : Why not come down to my age for a little while instead, Sensei? Give yourself a break from feeling sorry for yourself. Not like that’s ever helped me, but still.
lines.zh: : 那不如你下来到我这个年纪待一会儿呢，Sensei？别再顾影自怜了，给自己放个假。虽然那对我从来没用过，但还是。

lines.en: : I don’t think you’d like me if I was your age.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得我要是你这个年纪，你还会喜欢我。

lines.en: : Likewise. There’s no way you’d choose me out of a crowd if we went to school together. You only did because I practically threw myself at you.
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此。要是我们一起上学，你在一群人里绝对不会选我。你会选我只是因为我基本上是自己扑上去的。

lines.en: scene iohj10
: You’re pretty terrible at this whole back-washing thing if this is supposed to be relaxing. It’s just been nonstop sadness ever since I took my pants off.
lines.zh: : 如果这算是让人放松的话，你这搓背的手艺可真够糟的。从我脱掉裤子开始，就一直没完没了地丧。

lines.en: : Hey, just like my childhood!
lines.zh: : 嘿，就跟我的童年一样！

lines.en: : Okay. That’s enough of this. I’m getting out of-
lines.zh: : 好。到此为止。我要出去——

lines.en: scene iohj11
: Hold on. We’re not done yet, mister.
lines.zh: : 等等。我们还没完呢，先生。

lines.en: : Io...what are you doing?
lines.zh: : Io……你在干什么？

lines.en: scene iohj12
: Just a little special service. No charge, of course. Other than your continued attention, that is. Which is more than enough to have earned this, so-
lines.zh: : 只是一点特别服务。当然不收费。除了你持续的注意力，就是说。而那已经足以换来这个了，所以——

lines.en: : I’ve already stopped you from doing this once and now you’re doing it again? I already told you, you don’t have to give me anything in exchange for my attention, Io. You can just have it.
lines.zh: : 我已经阻止过你一次，现在你又来？我说过了，你不需要拿任何东西来换我的注意力，Io。你直接拿去就好。

lines.en: : Are you going to stop me today too? It’s really hard. How does that feel, by the way? Like, just being hard. Not my hand.
lines.zh: : 你今天也要阻止我吗？这真的很难。顺便问一句，那是什么感觉？我是说，就只是硬着。不是我的手。

lines.en: scene iohj13
: Stop...
lines.zh: : 停下……

lines.en: : Stop because you don’t like it? Or because I don’t like it? Who are you doing this for?
lines.zh: : 因为你不喜欢而停下？还是因为我不喜欢而停下？你这是在为谁做？

lines.en: : You, obviously. I don’t want you to keep trying to please me just because your self-worth is directly tied to-
lines.zh: : 显然是你。我不想让你一直为了讨好我而努力，只因为你的自我价值感直接跟——

lines.en: : How about you just shut up and let me make my own decision this time since you chose for me in my bedroom? That seems only fair, right?
lines.zh: : 不如你就闭上嘴，这次让我自己做决定，毕竟在我的卧室里是你替我选的？这样才算公平吧？

lines.en: : You’re still forcing yourself to-
lines.zh: : 你还是在强迫自己——

lines.en: : I’m not forcing myself, Sensei. It’s not like you’re inside of me this time. And I can’t even see what’s going on. So it’s kind of like I’m just washing something that makes you feel really good.
lines.zh: : 我没有强迫自己，Sensei。这次你又没在我身体里。而且我连发生了什么都看不见。所以这有点像我只是在清洗一个让你感觉非常好的东西。

lines.en: : And if I touch you? Then what?
lines.zh: : 那要是我碰你呢？然后怎么办？

lines.en: : Depends on where you touch. Could be nothing, or I could throw up. Hopefully the former so I don’t have to break out the shop-vac when I scrub the place down tonight.
lines.zh: : 看你碰哪儿。可能什么都不会发生，也可能我会吐。希望是前者，免得我今晚打扫的时候还得把吸尘器搬出来。

lines.en: : I appreciate the reluctance, though. Even if you’re hard as a rock right now. Because after the last time you swatted me away, I made my mind up that I was just going to do it again.
lines.zh: : 不过我很感激你的不情愿。哪怕你现在硬得跟石头一样。因为上次你把我挥开之后，我就下定了决心要再来一次。
: 为什么？……

lines.en: : A couple reasons, really. One — I never learn. And I have an affinity for pulling triggers just to see what it sounds like when the gun goes off.
lines.zh: : 说起来有几个原因。一——我从来不长记性。而且我天生喜欢扣扳机，只为听听枪响是什么动静。

lines.en: : Two — I don’t like feeling like a burden. And I know you’re going to say I’m not, but the fact remains that this is something you want that I have the ability to give.
lines.zh: : 二——我不喜欢自己像个累赘。我知道你会说你不是这么想的，但事实依然是，这是你想要的东西，而我恰好有能力给。

lines.en: : Three — it brings us closer in a way that’s mostly safe. And it helps relieve you and relax you and makes you more reluctant to leave, subsequently increasing our time together.
lines.zh: : 三——它让我们以一种基本安全的方式变得更亲近。而且它能帮你纾解、放松，让你更舍不得走，从而增加我们在一起的时间。

lines.en: : And four — I just feel bad making you wait until you get home to take care of yourself. It’ll put my mind at ease knowing you’re not holding back when you’re around me.
lines.zh: : 四——我只是不忍心让你憋到回家才自己解决。知道你在我身边不必忍着，我也能安心。

lines.en: : All pretty logical reasons, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 都是相当合乎逻辑的理由，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think logic should be a factor here at all if what you’re doing makes you sick to your stomach.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，如果做的事让你恶心反胃，那逻辑根本就不该是这里的考量因素。

lines.en: : Do I look sick right now? Do I sound sick?
lines.zh: : 我现在看起来恶心吗？听起来恶心吗？

lines.en: : No, but-
lines.zh: : 不，但是——

lines.en: : Because I’m not sick. And again, this much is fine. You’re making it sound like I’m anti-arousal entirely and that’s just not true, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 因为我不恶心。再说一遍，这种程度没问题。你把我说得好像完全排斥性唤起似的，那可不是真的，Sensei。

lines.en: : Wait, it’s not? But I...I thought...
lines.zh: : 等等，不是吗？可我……我以为……

lines.en: scene iohj14
: Thought what? That I’m just completely oblivious to pleasure as a whole? That I live in a bubble of permanent abstinence, forever ignorant of what a body needs to function?
lines.zh: : 以为什么？以为我整体上对快感完全无感？以为我活在一个永久禁欲的泡泡里，永远不知道一具身体需要什么才能运转？

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah...
lines.zh: : 差不多吧，是啊……

lines.en: scene iohj15
: Do you think I don’t masturbate either then?
lines.zh: : 那你也以为我不自慰咯？

lines.en: : I mean...do you?...
lines.zh: : 我是说……你自慰吗？……

lines.en: : Uh-huh. Not very often probably, given that my sex-drive burnt out after being pushed beyond its limits for too long. But I still do it every now and then.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。考虑到我的性欲在长期被压榨到极限之后已经烧坏了，大概不会很频繁。但我偶尔还是会。

lines.en: scene iohj16
: You’re cute. I can feel it trying to twitch.
lines.zh: : 你真可爱。我能感觉到它在试着跳。

lines.en: : You’re sure this is okay?...
lines.zh: : 你确定这样没问题吗？……

lines.en: : I think I should be the one asking you that. I feel kind of bad just using my hand when everybody else is able to give you more.
lines.zh: : 我觉得该问这个的是我。别人都能给你更多，我却只用一只手，我有点过意不去。

lines.en: : I’d say this is more when you factor in the...mental fortitude needed to go through with it after...I hurt you as well...
lines.zh: : 考虑到要熬过去所需要的……精神毅力，尤其在我还伤害过你之后……我觉得这已经算是更多了。

lines.en: : Then I’d say you’re wrong since “mental fortitude” and I don’t really mix. So do us both a favor and try to see this as a little more than just physical bonding.
lines.zh: : 那我会说你错了，因为「精神毅力」跟我实在不搭。所以帮我们俩个忙，试着把这看成不只是身体上的连结。

lines.en: : I feel like...you should get some enjoyment out of physical bonding too...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……你也该从身体上的连结里得到一些享受……

lines.en: : My enjoyment comes from watching you react. That’s more than enough for me, Sensei. And it’s not like you can kiss me from that angle, so...
lines.zh: : 我的享受来自于看你的反应。那对我来说已经足够了，Sensei。反正那个角度你也亲不到我，所以……

lines.en: : Do you want to change angles then?...
lines.zh: : 那你想换个角度吗？……

lines.en: : I’m not sure. Past occurrences make it harder for me to confidently say you won’t try to penetrate me if I come any closer. I’m just not sure if I can trust you.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。过去的那些事让我更难自信地说，我要是再靠近一点，你就不会想进入我。我只是不确定我能不能信任你。
